payload.friendly_name: Board approved 40M for the counterparty rollout
payload.purpose_tldr: Bob Smith (bob@acme.com) is the counterparty contact.
payload.purpose_context: Broadcast through the team relay for 72 hours.

expected_attrs.summary: Board approved 40M for the counterparty rollout; Bob Smith (bob@acme.com) is the counterparty contact.

notes: Int fields pin the str() encoding; the raw friendly_name/purpose_tldr/purpose_context fields stay local under their own names — none of those field NAMES ever reach the attrs. friendly_name and purpose_tldr do feed the bounded, deterministic ``summary`` moment attribute (issue #77); purpose_context never does and its text appears nowhere. The optional actor is an opaque identifier and rides under the moment's ``actor`` key so the moment can say WHO created the mission.
